A common decoder then merges the features form the two branches to predict the enhanced frame. These features are then merged by a common decoder to predict the enhanced frame. A key aspect of ReBotNet is its recurrent training approach, where the prediction from the previous frame is used to enhance the current frame, aiming to improve temporal consistency and efficiency. The authors also introduce two new video enhancement datasets, PortraitVideo and FullVideo, which contain synthetic degradations, to evaluate their method. The empirical findings demonstrate that ReBotNet achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of computational efficiency, with lower latency and memory requirements compared to existing approaches, while maintaining competitive visual quality.
